safe_zone._platform_comment: Founder rule 14 (2026-09-28): text above y 1420 and left of x 960 below y 850, or it lands under Instagram's description/name/buttons. Strict = fails --final.
safe_zone._comment: Founder rule 14: readable things live in y 250..1420 and, below y 850, left of x 960 (IG/TikTok description, name, like/comment/share column).

fonts._comment: RushPoint rule (relayed by אודי 2026-10-01): only Inter, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono. None has a Hebrew glyph, so Hebrew falls back to the system font; 'hebrew_fallback' names it explicitly (Arial, bold) so the fallback is deterministic in both HTML and libass instead of whatever the OS picks. To return to the app's Rubik/Assistant pair, set display/body back and hebrew_fallback to the same names.

money._rate_comment: ILS per 1 USD. Update on edit day (Bank of Israel representative rate). The receipt's dollar line renders TODO until this is a number.

landscape._comment: RP_FORMAT=landscape (16:9, projected in a classroom). Merged over the blocks of the same name.
